Thank you for your interest in the Department of Statistics at Nelson
Mandela University. It is my pleasure to confirm the arrangements for your
forthcoming visit to our Gqeberha campus.

We have scheduled a research seminar for the morning of your arrival, followed
by individual meetings with members of our postgraduate research group. A
detailed itinerary will follow under separate cover.

Please do not hesitate to contact me should you require any further
information ahead of your visit.
